main_text.p: tiplicare. Unde Futurum Syriac. ܢܣܒ Et augebit, 2. ad Corinth. 9. 10. Educare, nutrire, augere, augescere, crescere, germinare facere, producere, educere: Ungere, inungere ad officium aliquod, quasi extollere ad illud: Foenerare, in usuram dare, quod fit auctione, Deuteron. 23. 20. Ithpah. אִתְרַבֵּי Magnum fieri, magnificari, extolli, magnificare, evehere, extollere se: Nutriri, educari: Ungi: In foenus, usuram dari, Deuteron. 23. 20. Crescere, Florere, germinare, Jesa. 44. 4. Aphel Praeteritum אַרְבִּיר Pullulavit, crevit, Psalm. 85. 12. Partic. מַרְבֵּי Germinare facit, Jesa. 55. verf. 10. Plural. וּמַרְבִּין Et crescere, germinare faciunt, Genef. 27. 28. in Jonat. Sic Cantic. 5. 13.
רִבְוּתָא, רִבְוּת, רְבוּ Ch. Amplitudo, magnificentia, dignitas: Item Unctio, Psf. 92. 11.

רַבְיָא, רַבִּי, רַבֵּי Ch. Puer, Puerulus, Adolescens, qui adhuc crescit. Plural. רַבְיִין. Cum Aff. רַבְיָהָא Parvuli ejus, Thren. 1. 5. & ab alia forma, רוּבִין, Thren. 5. 13, 14. const. רוּבֵיהַנָּא Pueri sacerdotis, Esth. 1. 15. Foem. רִבְיָא רַבָּא Puella, juvencula, adolescentula.
רִבְיוּתָא רְבִיּוּרְ Ch. Pueritia, adolescentia, juventus: Item Amplitudo, magnificentia, Psal. 71. 21.
מַרְבִּי מַרְבֵּי Ch. Nutriens, nutritius. Foem. מַרְבִּיתָה Nutrix ejus, Genef. 35. 8. in T. H.

מְרַבְּיָן Chald. Nutriti, educati, alumni. Constr. מַרְבֵּיֵי בֵיתֵיהּ Nutritos in domo sua, Genef. 14. 14. in Jonath. Targum Hierosolym. habet מַרְבִּיצִי. Sic Psalm. 65. 11. pro מַרְבִּיצִי צְמַחֵהָא in Psalterio Nebiensi est מַרְבִּיצִי
